messages:
harper_cs: Quick capture from three calls today  recurring asks + one clear renewal concern. Want a tiny triage before tomorrows renewal check-in. Buckets below, pls react.
noel_onboard: saw this across Helio and ClearHarbor pilots. Finance asked for chargeback-level detail per team/route.
rachel_prod: drop the asks + severity and I'll add to intake with a rough LOE.
harper_cs: asks: 
1) granular chargeback export (high) 00 customers want per-team/route lines that map to their internal cost centers; must include date, team_tag, route, env, model_variant, tokens, cost_usd, invoice_reference. (renewal-risk: ClearHarbor in 3w)
2) webhook-triggered embedding refresh (med-high) 00 when new docs arrive they want an API/webhook to kick re-embed for specific datasets rather than full scheduled runs.
3) interactive onboarding checklist (med) 00 short step-by-step in Console with checkboxes and links to common troubleshooting tips.
4) latency-safe mode (low-med) 00 an opt-in route policy to cap queueing and return early errors instead of long tails.
sam_engineering: Quick Q: chargeback export needs invoice parity or reconciliable aggregates? Also webhook re-embed sounds like a job queue hook1 any rough volume expectations?
harper_cs: they want numbers they can plug into chargeback tools (reconcilable). Webhook volume is low for pilots (<10 calls/day per org) but could spike.
rachel_prod: Proposed triage: mark chargeback export as P0 for accounts with renewals <6w. Webhook re-embed as P1, onboarding checklist P2, latency-safe mode P3. We'll validate impact x confidence in triage.
noel_onboard: I'll tag historical tickets with `feedback:chargeback-export` and add two verbatim customer quotes to the GH issue.
notify_bot: Reminder: CS/Product sync tomorrow 09:00 PT 1 thread auto-added to "renewal risks" agenda.
sam_engineering: Action: I'll sketch a minimal CSV schema and a simple webhook prototype for re-embed by EOD Friday.
harper_cs: please mark ClearHarbor high-risk in the renewal tracker and include a one-page mitigation ask if prototype looks feasible. Thanks all.
